purpose: export one complete left-facing non-rest gait pose from the retained hidden-3D motion/topology backbone as guide/control evidence for native-2D pose authoring
locked_architecture: real motion -> hidden 3D full pose guide -> persistent native-2D pose asset -> sprite playback

input_body_identity_anchor.role: static left-facing identity/body-style anchor only; not deformed into the gait pose

event.selection: choose the validated phase with anatomical left foot leading in source travel and strongest contact-like foot separation/grounding score

depth_guide.reason: MPFB source and evaluated/deformed mesh polygon counts are not 1:1; depth materials are assigned directly on a frozen copy of the evaluated topology for this guide-only pose

pass_requirement: guide package must show one coherent left-facing full-body contact pose with explicit anatomical laterality, near/far ownership, depth ordering, contact metadata, 128px camera scale and screen-left travel vector; only after visual review may C1B author one native-2D pose candidate
